name: cpython
notes: Redistributed inside the desktop installer (resources/core). LICENSE.txt carries the notices of CPython (PSF-2.0 and its history, 0BSD for documentation code), bzip2, Zstandard and Tcl/Tk (Tcl/Tk itself is left out of the core). It does not carry the notices of the other libraries the distribution and the locked wheels bundle, among them OpenSSL (libssl/libcrypto, Apache-2.0, also inside the cryptography wheel), libffi (MIT), SQLite (public domain), zlib (Zlib), liblzma (0BSD), mpdecimal (BSD-2-Clause), expat (MIT) and HACL* (MIT); those must be collected into the installer's notices file before any public release (E08, decision 0054). This list is not exhaustive.
